sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.text_preview: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for a web-based platform connecting NGOs (who host events and need volunteers) with individuals/students (who want to volunteer).

sections.title: 2. Scope
sections.text_preview:
The system provides:
- Self-service NGO registration with **immediate event-publishing rights** (no pre-approval gate)
- Background NGO document verification that affects only a trust badge, not publi

sections.title: 4.5 Search & Filtering
sections.text_preview:
- FR-17: System shall default to showing events within a **10km radius** of the volunteer's saved location.
- FR-18: Volunteer shall be able to adjust the radius (e.g., 5/10/25/50km or custom slider).
